# First form checklist

Use this list after you walk through the [Your first form](/your-first-form/create-your-first-form) tutorials.

:::tip Try it

<a href="#" onclick="openMinimalWindow('https://demo.formengine.io/?&formName=add-fields-with-button&view=mui'); return false;">Open finished first form in demo</a> - opens the FormEngine demo in a popup window with the form this article starts from.

:::

## Create and layout

- Form open on the canvas (new or sample)
- At least one layout container if you have multiple sections
- Fields added from **Components**

## Data capture

- Each field has a clear **Key** on **Main** ([Name fields for data](/your-first-form/name-fields-for-data-capture))
- Labels and placeholders read clearly

## Validation

- Required or **Non empty** rule on critical fields ([Validation](/your-first-form/add-validation-on-your-first-form))
- Messages are user-friendly ([Custom error messages](/behavior-and-validation/custom-error-messages))

## Actions

- Submit or **Save** button configured on **Actions** ([Button actions](/your-first-form/add-button-actions-on-your-first-form))
- Validate runs before submit if needed ([Action order](/behavior-and-validation/action-order-on-buttons))

## Preview

- **Preview** tested, **Edit** used to fix issues ([Preview your first form](/your-first-form/preview-your-first-form))
- **Validate** and **Data** checked in Preview ([Preview mode tools](/preview-and-handoff/use-preview-mode-tools-data-validate-reset))

## Handoff

- Form exported or saved per team process ([Export and share](/preview-and-handoff/export-and-share-your-form))
- Ready for [testing checklist](/preview-and-handoff/testing-checklist-before-handoff) before production

## Summary

This checklist closes the first-form learning path. For production, use the full testing checklist.
